pairs.why: A's pink diagonal stripes are softer and closer in tone to the real card's quiet stripes, while B's stripes are more saturated and contrasty.
Both use the same quiet red argyle backdrop and a plain orange ledge, so staging and detail give no reason to choose.
B stands on plain dirt with a few pebbles, while A's grey ground is crowded with craters and rocks that add environment noise the real cards don't have.
B keeps the real card's simple sea, sand and sky, while A adds a palm, beach ball, starfish, shell and rock that the real card doesn't have.
Both swap the real card's soft spotlight vignette for a radiating-ray burst, and both put the kit on a similar red dais.
A keeps the table large and central with a few big quiet shapes, like the real card, while B shrinks the table and lets the path, bushes and flowers compete with it.
Both use the same tone-on-tone wavy purple backdrop with a floating hero, so staging gives no reason to choose.
B's truss runs horizontally across the top edge like the real card's, while A's diagonal truss and vented lamp add more small detail.
